entries.0c1baf3367532fca: A business that provided the click-billing advertisement "StoreMatch" and the CRM tool "STORE's R∞" for stores in online malls. Both services ended provision as of July 31, 2025. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥9,831 million.
entries.1466e24f254ede08: A hotel management system (Property Management System) for hotels, ryokan and other accommodation facilities. In addition to the basic functions of reservation management, front-desk accounting and customer management, it offers options such as pre-check-in and room settlement, and is provided with full support 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The former service name was "Dynalution (Dynalution)".
entries.19f1eab39d81291b: A business that provides solutions supporting customer acquisition and DX for accommodation facilities. The corporate brand of DYNATECH Co., Ltd., which was merged into the company by absorption in April 2025, was succeeded to, and in September of the same year the business brand was rebranded to "DYNATECH." Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,312 million.
entries.1c99e3c862ee0438: A format in which the advertiser is provided with the ValueCommerce Affiliate Program, the core system. The advertiser runs the affiliate through an administration screen, and pays basic system usage management fees and the like, as well as performance rewards to media operators and commissions according to the amount of those rewards.
entries.41f841359ac2ab97: A company that provides commerce operators with marketing solutions from customer attraction to customer retention, centered on performance-based advertising "affiliate."
entries.608b0371861b9390: A business that provides solutions supporting customer acquisition and sales promotion for commerce operators, whose main service is the performance-based advertising "affiliate." Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥13,025 million, making it the largest business of the group.
entries.87b6887f6e850ef8: A format in which the company collectively undertakes, on a consignment basis, the planning, operation and management of advertising methods that achieve optimal advertising effects through affiliate advertising, for advertisers. Advertisers pay a fixed monthly fee and performance rewards according to advertising results.
entries.9b5ee94550554ce8: A CRM tool for stores in online malls. Provision ended as of July 31, 2025.
entries.ac99058d176b989a: An accommodation booking system for accommodation facilities such as hotels and ryokan. It can be listed with the company's own booking plans on "Google Hotel Ads" and "Yahoo! Search," and has point and coupon functions, advance payment functions and similar features. The former service name was "Direct In."
entries.bc6eecc8d494a1e1: A format in which optional services are provided to advertisers, such as advertising placement with media operators, which are expected to create synergies with affiliate advertising. In March 2025, the influencer marketing platform "BUZMA" was incorporated as a group service, in July of the same year the company started providing a CPC-dedicated program for SNS media, and in December it started providing the performance-based advertising solution "Reward DSP."
entries.ec4bf22a5d0034af: A click-billing advertisement for stores in online malls. Provision ended as of July 31, 2025.
